layout.arrangement: No title bar: the entire slide is one full-bleed, vertically stacked, bottom-to-top data-flow diagram of a Transformer encoder, centered on a white slide enclosed by a thin dark-red border frame. A column of 5 colored section labels runs down the left margin (Single vector note, Output Sequence, Input Sequence, Word Embedding Vectors, Position Information Vectors). From bottom to top: Input Sequence container (two dashed sub-rows joined by a red '+' circle) → blue up-arrow → Transformer Encoder stack (three dark-red bars) → blue up-arrow → Output Sequence row → blue up-arrow → Global Average Pooling box → blue up-arrow → single pooled-vector row of colored squares → fan of thin red lines → tan Softmax Layer bar with three circles → C₁/C₂/C₃ class labels under 'Output Classes'. Slide-number badge '59' at top-right.

visual_elements.description: Vertical bottom-to-top Transformer Encoder architecture. Nodes bottom→top: (1) Input Sequence: bottom sub-row of 8 white boxes labeled Vector_{P0}, Vector_{P1}, Vector_{P2}, Vector_{P3}, Vector_{P4}, Vector_{P5}, then 5 green dots, then Vector_{P_{N-2}}, Vector_{P_{N-1}}; a red circle with white '+' above it; top sub-row of 8 white boxes labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄, X₅, then 5 green dots, then X_{N-2}, X_{N-1}. Each X/Y box shows its bold-italic label followed by 2-3 tiny colored cells (yellow/green/pink) representing vector dimensions. (2) Blue up-arrow into a red container holding three dark-red bars each labeled 'Transformer Block', with ~6-7 columns of white vertical three-dot ellipses between the middle and bottom bars and bold white 'Transformer Encoder' overlaid center. (3) Blue up-arrow into Output Sequence: 8 blue-bordered boxes Y₁…Y₅, 5 blue dots, Y_{N-2}, Y_{N-1}. (4) Blue up-arrow into white 'Global Average Pooling' box. (5) Blue up-arrow into a single row of ~30 small squares alternating yellow/green/pink (the whole-sequence vector). (6) A fan of thin dark-red lines rises from this row and converges on the red base node of each of the three navy circles labeled 'Softmax' with Σ, which sit on a tan bar labeled 'Softmax Layer'. (7) Small thin up-arrows from each circle to C₁, C₂, C₃ beneath the blue 'Output Classes' label.

Five container shapes: (a) 'Input Sequence' light-pink (#FADBD8) rounded rectangle enclosing both input sub-rows and the '+' node; (b) green dashed rounded rectangle (no fill) around the word-embedding row; (c) orange dashed rounded rectangle with peach (#FDEBD0) fill around the position-vector row; (d) blue dashed rounded rectangle with light-blue (#D6EAF8) fill around the output-sequence row; (e) muted red (#CD5C5C) rectangle enclosing the three Transformer Block bars.
